policy: All 44 registered API models receive the byte-identical new initial prompt. One conditional execution repair for empty, truncated or unexecutable code; final response only, never best-of. No aesthetic feedback or organizer code edits. Every terminal creative response is included in tokens and price. No inherited V3 output is presented as V4.
transportPolicy: One unchanged retry on interrupted transport or retryable 408/429/5xx. Deterministic API validation rejections are not resampled. Missing terminal usage remains explicitly unknown. A received terminal response is normalized without another model call.
versionPolicy: Foundry deployment metadata must match the previously tested model and version. Google uses named publisher identifiers and retains actual returned modelVersion, including explicitly named previews. No latest aliases or routers.
newElement: A physically coherent jump over one shallow puddle, dry landing and masked water reflection, followed by the original doghouse and bone sequence.
sourcePolicy: No V3 scene, recording or usage is reused in V4. Original code is preserved; only an enclosing HTML Markdown fence and surrounding whitespace may be removed.

transportCorrections.reason: Organizer sent unsupported stream_options.include_usage. Provider returned HTTP 422 before inference. Restore the previously verified non-streaming JSON route, preserving the new initial prompt, pinned model/version, 32768 output allowance and actual terminal usage.

transportCorrections.policy: Retryable 408/429/5xx responses and interrupted transports without terminal usage are conservatively flagged as unknown additional usage. Only deterministic validation rejections are excluded. Do not interpret a missing token receipt as zero charge. Original request/response diagnostics are preserved; no provider response, source or usage is changed.
